band_amendment.when: after a pre-run calibration on DISJOINT seeds (901-904), BEFORE the scored battery; the battery seeds (1-3) and every scored number below were not touched during calibration

confidence_bands_measured_and_frozen.classifier_note: during pre-run calibration the glyph matcher moved from binarized-mask NCC to ANTIALIASED-GRAYSCALE NCC (continuous stroke-edge profile; binary thresholds set stroke weight arbitrarily and collapsed same-font margins) with PER-FONT reference heights (a table's h0 is its own font's digit height; a cross-font median left every non-median font 9% mis-scaled).  Same-font glyph scores rose to ~1.0 with 0.13-0.36 margins.
confidence_bands_measured_and_frozen.derivation: the a-priori bands (0.90/0.95, 0.75/0.90) assumed same-size rendering; the gray-NCC calibration (seeds 901-904, disjoint from battery seeds 1-3) measured true-cell conf_min p01 0.79-0.93 and conf_mean p01 0.86-0.96 across the tiers, and the numeric WRONG-read envelope never passed the bands (numeric wrong-and-admitted = 0 across ~4500 calibration cells), so the frozen bands stand above the wrong envelope while the LOW band absorbs soft-but-correct reads (flagged, never admitted)

rendering_class_clarification.original_line: 2x supersample -> LANCZOS downscale for all tiers
rendering_class_clarification.amended: clean = born-digital class, rendered native-crisp (supersample 1, rasterizer antialiasing only -- the PMC tables are born-digital vector renders); realistic/hostile = scanned class, rendered at 2x with rotation+noise applied at high resolution then LANCZOS-downscaled (the 600-dpi scan class)
rendering_class_clarification.why: the pre-run calibration showed the 2x-downscale rendering softens even undegraded tables (clean exact recovery 0.878 at 2x vs 0.980 native) -- the pre-registered rendering line did not anticipate this tier interaction; the clean tier's own definition (P1, the born-digital sanity ceiling) requires the crisp rendering
rendering_class_clarification.hostile_note: hostile fails at BOTH renderings (exact 0.016 at 2x, 0.000 at native) -- the hostile degradation class is beyond this machinery; the receipt's F1 hostile branch (de-scope to born-digital + scanned-realistic) applies and the red is reported

key_vs_value_classes.amended: P3 applies to VALUE cells (the numbers). Muscle-name cells are ROW KEYS: a misread key is not a wrong number -- the admission adapter resolves names through a closed vocabulary/homology table and REFUSES unknown names (unknown_muscle), so a misread key can never silently attach values to the wrong muscle. Name-cell exact recovery keeps its own pre-registered band.
key_vs_value_classes.why: the calibration's only confident wrong reads were 3 name cells (space-insertion artifacts); values had zero wrong admits across ~4500 calibration cells

rule0.statement: The Vanhoof S1/S2 tables-in-images are extractable to ADMISSION GRADE without tesseract: a deterministic grid-detection + template-matching (NCC) pipeline recovers every clean/realistic-class cell exactly with calibrated per-cell confidence, flags low-confidence cells (never admits them), refuses ambiguous cells BY NAME, and any residual confident-but-wrong digit that survives OCR is converted into a VISIBLE row quarantine by the Guimaraes closure laws run on the extracted rows.
prediction: P1 clean-tier exact numeric-cell recovery >= 0.99; name-cell exact recovery >= 0.98
P2 realistic-tier exact numeric-cell recovery >= 0.96, name-cell >= 0.95; hostile-tier numeric >= 0.88
P3 wrong-and-admitted = 0 in EVERY tier (a cell is admitted only if read exactly AND confident; a guessed number never enters the admitted set)
P4 of the non-exactly-recovered cells: >= 85% (realistic) and >= 75% (hostile) are flagged LOW or REFUSED with a named code (segmentation merges, never guesses)
P5 all 6 crafted ambiguity plates refuse with their SPECIFIC named codes and none emits a value

P6 corruption battery: every above-tolerance (+5%) single-cell corruption is quarantined by the row laws EXACTLY at its own row (admitted-row count drops by exactly that row's record count, rejection count +1); the declared +1% floor replica is ADMITTED (the tolerance floor is real and declared, not hidden)
P7 determinism: two full extraction+admission passes over identical TIFF bytes produce byte-identical canonical JSON
P8 every admitted record carries full provenance: tiff sha256, sheet id, cell row/col + bbox, per-glyph + cell confidence, route tag; and passes the class contract batch.property.measurement v1
falsifier: F1 any tier's recovery below its band, or wrong-and-admitted > 0 anywhere -> the route fails AT THAT TIER; a hostile-tier failure de-scopes the route's claim to born-digital + scanned-realistic tables (the real PMC TIFFs are born-digital vector renders, i.e. cleaner than the hostile tier) instead of killing the lane; a clean/realistic failure or any wrong-and-admitted kills the route outright
F2 any crafted ambiguity plate admits a value, or refuses with only a generic code instead of its named class -> the refusal taxonomy dies and must be re-registered, not patched silently
F3 an above-tolerance corruption admitted through OCR+laws -> the admission class 'never a guessed number' dies

F4 extraction/admission JSON byte-differs between two runs over identical bytes -> the determinism claim dies (tesseract could not have made this claim; this is part of why the fallback route was chosen)
F5 an admitted record missing any provenance field -> the adapter dies

confidence_bands_preregistered.note: Derived from template-matching statistics BEFORE the run (identical glyphs after Otsu binarization score NCC ~0.97-1.0; distinct digits cross-font >= 0.90; confusable pairs 1/7 5/6 8/3 4/9 land 0.75-0.90; below 0.75 identity is not evidence). Bands are NOT retuned after results; a miscalibration is reported as a red and requires a NEW pre-registration.
confidence_bands_preregistered.classes: CONFIDENT -> EXTRACTED-CONFIDENT (admittable); below band -> EXTRACTED-LOW-CONFIDENCE (flagged, NEVER admitted); structural anomaly or margin breach -> REFUSED (named code)

route.tesseract_check: PATH (where/which), C:/Program Files/Tesseract-OCR, C:/Program Files (x86), %LOCALAPPDATA%/Programs, %LOCALAPPDATA%/Tesseract-OCR, chocolatey bin: all absent; pytesseract module absent
route.why: (1) no tesseract binary on this host and no license to install host software from a data lane; (2) the target class is born-digital PMC TIFF renders with a closed glyph alphabet and known column vocabulary - a template classifier with NCC confidence + named refusals is admission-grade (never guesses, always carries evidence); (3) determinism is provable byte-for-byte, which a versioned external OCR cannot promise; (4) zero new dependencies (numpy 2.2.6 + PIL 12.2.0 already present).
route.declared_circularity: Synthetic tables are rendered from the SAME font bank the templates are built from, so synthetic recovery is an upper bound for real-table recovery: the battery proves the MACHINERY (grid segmentation, confidence calibration on the synthetic class, refusal discipline, law conversion of residual errors), NOT real-Vanhoof recovery. The day-of runbook's FIRST step is a one-table calibration on the real S1 TIFF to measure the domain gap before any record is admitted.
route.declared_floor: Corruptions below the laws' 2% tolerance are undetectable by construction (no observer can separate them); the +1% floor replica in the corruption battery pre-registers this floor ADMITTED rather than hiding it.

battery.table_shape: 30 rows x (1 muscle-name column + 7 specimen numeric columns Mm1..Mm7 + 1 mean±sd numeric column); numeric values DERIVED from the closure laws (mass, FL seeded; PCSA := m/(rho*FL); volume := m/rho; MTU := FL + tendon_ext + tendon_int) - no free parameters

battery.rendering: grayscale L, 2x supersample -> LANCZOS downscale, TIFF LZW, deterministic

laws_adapter.density_closure: |volume_m3 * 1060 - mass_kg| / mass_kg <= 0.02, per row, quarantine on violation (code density_closure_violation)
laws_adapter.pcsa_closure: |mass_kg/(1060 * fl_m) - pcsa_m2| / pcsa_m2 <= 0.02, per row, quarantine (code pcsa_closure_violation)
laws_adapter.mtu_additivity: |fl_m + tendon_ext_m + tendon_int_m - mtu_m| / mtu_m <= 0.02 quarantine (code mtu_additivity_violation); NOTE for the real tables: Vanhoof's own MTU/fascicle/tendon definitions must be measured first (runbook step 3) - if the deviation is continuous the law demotes to a recorded condition, exactly the Guimaraes length-additivity discipline
laws_adapter.decimal_register: per numeric column, cells whose decimal-place count deviates from the column mode (mode must cover >= 0.80 of column) refuse as decimal_ambiguous - the table's own formatting regularity used as a closure law
laws_adapter.no_blanks: empty/zero/negative cells refuse (codes blank_cell, nonpositive_value); nonnumeric text in a numeric column refuses (nonnumeric_cell)
laws_adapter.unknown_header: a column header outside the manifest variants refuses the sheet (unknown_or_duplicate_header)
laws_adapter.count_identity: fetched == admitted + refused (+ flagged counted inside refused), zero silent drops, reported per table
laws_adapter.units: SI via tools/science_funnel/units.convert: g->kg, cm3->m3, mm->m, mm2->m2; rho = 1060 kg/m3 (the in-repo Guimaraes law constant; the memo flags its own admission-grade citation requirement for first REAL use - unchanged by this lane)

honest_classes: EXTRACTED-CONFIDENT: exact read, bands met, laws pass -> admitted record
EXTRACTED-LOW-CONFIDENCE: readable but below the confidence bands -> flagged rejection row (code low_confidence_cell), NEVER admitted, value preserved in the refusal detail for operator hand-review

REFUSED: named refusal code (glyph_merge, decimal_ambiguous, ambiguous_glyph, low_contrast, grid_collision, cell_clipped, low_glyph_confidence, blank_cell, nonnumeric_cell, nonpositive_value, unknown_or_duplicate_header, *law violations), never admitted
scope_limits: no real Vanhoof bytes processed in this lane (downloads pending with the operator); no admission of any real record happens here
synthetic recovery does not certify real-table recovery (declared_circularity); runbook step 1 gates the real day
the +1%-corruption floor replica is PRE-REGISTERED ADMITTED: the laws cannot see below 2%; this is the honest boundary of the machinery, not a failure
